translationRepairs: At that time Prince of Yueyang Bainian was crown prince; Gao Zhan, because the Hulü family for generations had been pure and careful and Hulü Guang had also shown merit to the royal house, took his eldest daughter as the crown prince's consort.

At that time Bainian, Prince of Leling, was crown prince. Emperor Xiaozhao, because the Hulü family had been upright and cautious for generations and Hulü Guang had rendered distinguished service to the imperial house, took Guang's eldest daughter as the crown prince's consort.
肅宗 is Emperor Xiaozhao (Gao Yan), whereas Gao Zhan was Shizu. The revision also corrects 樂陵 from Yueyang to Leling and makes the subject of 納其長女 explicit without changing the source's meaning.
